# NBA.com

> Official website of the National Basketball Association featuring scores, schedules, standings, stats, news, video, and league coverage.

NBA.com is the league’s primary digital platform for fans, media, and developers seeking live game information, team and player data, highlights, editorial coverage, and access to official league properties.

## Scores, Schedule & Standings
- [Scores](https://www.nba.com/games): Live and upcoming NBA game scores, matchups, and game status.
- [Schedule](https://www.nba.com/schedule): Full NBA schedule with dates, tip times, and broadcast details.
- [Standings](https://www.nba.com/standings): Conference and division standings, records, and playoff positioning.
- [Playoffs](https://www.nba.com/playoffs): NBA Playoffs hub with bracket, schedule, scores, and news.
- [NBA Cup](https://www.nba.com/nba-cup/2024): NBA Cup overview with tournament schedule, standings, and results.
- [All-Star](https://www.nba.com/allstar): NBA All-Star coverage, events, rosters, and announcements.

## Stats & Leaders
- [Stats Home](https://www.nba.com/stats/): Official NBA stats portal for players, teams, games, and tracking data.
- [Players](https://www.nba.com/stats/players): Player statistics, splits, advanced metrics, and filters.
- [Teams](https://www.nba.com/stats/teams): Team statistical rankings, advanced stats, and lineup data.
- [Leaders](https://www.nba.com/stats/leaders): League leaders across scoring, rebounding, assists, and more.
- [Lineups](https://www.nba.com/stats/lineups): Lineup combinations with net rating and possession-based metrics.
- [Draft](https://www.nba.com/stats/draft): Draft class statistics and historical player performance data.
- [Players Traditional](https://www.nba.com/stats/players/traditional): Traditional box score stats for all NBA players.
- [Teams Advanced](https://www.nba.com/stats/teams/advanced): Advanced team metrics including offensive and defensive ratings.

## Players, Teams & Rosters
- [Players Index](https://www.nba.com/players): Directory of NBA players with profiles and bio information.
- [Teams Index](https://www.nba.com/teams): Directory of all NBA teams with links to official team sites.
- [Transactions](https://www.nba.com/players/transactions): Official player movement, signings, waivers, and roster transactions.
- [Injury Report](https://www.nba.com/injury-report): Daily injury report with player availability and status updates.
- [Free Agents](https://www.nba.com/freeagents): Free agency news, signings, and offseason movement coverage.
- [Draft Hub](https://www.nba.com/draft): NBA Draft news, picks, prospects, and event coverage.

## News & Features
- [News](https://www.nba.com/news): Latest NBA news, analysis, and feature stories from league reporters.
- [Power Rankings](https://www.nba.com/news/tag/power-rankings): Weekly team rankings and league-wide analysis.
- [Rookie Ladder](https://www.nba.com/news/tag/kia-rookie-ladder): Ongoing rankings and evaluation of top rookies.
- [Kia MVP Ladder](https://www.nba.com/news/tag/kia-mvp-ladder): Regular MVP race updates and candidate analysis.
- [History](https://www.nba.com/history): Historical league milestones, champions, and notable moments.
- [Awards](https://www.nba.com/awards): League awards information, winners, and season honors.

## Video & Media
- [Video](https://www.nba.com/watch/video): Official NBA video hub for highlights, recaps, and features.
- [Highlights](https://www.nba.com/watch/video/highlights): Game highlights, top plays, and condensed video clips.
- [Game Recaps](https://www.nba.com/watch/video/game-recaps): Short-form recaps summarizing completed NBA games.
- [NBA TV](https://www.nba.com/watch/nba-tv): NBA TV programming and featured video content.
- [Podcasts](https://www.nba.com/podcasts): Official NBA podcasts, episodes, and show information.

## League Coverage
- [NBA G League](https://gleague.nba.com/): Official NBA G League site with scores, teams, and player development news.
- [WNBA](https://www.wnba.com/): Official WNBA site with scores, standings, and league coverage.
- [NBA 2K League](https://www.nba.com/2kleague): NBA 2K League coverage and esports-related content.
- [Basketball Africa League](https://bal.nba.com/): Official Basketball Africa League site with teams and competition news.
- [Jr. NBA](https://jr.nba.com/): Youth basketball programs, coaching resources, and participation initiatives.
- [NBA Cares](https://community.nba.com/): NBA social impact and community outreach initiatives.

## Fans & Experiences
- [League Pass](https://www.nba.com/watch/league-pass-stream): NBA League Pass subscription and streaming information.
- [Tickets](https://www.nba.com/tickets): Ticket access and links to team ticketing pages.
- [Fantasy](https://www.nba.com/fantasy): Fantasy basketball news, tools, and game-related content.
- [Pick'Em](https://www.nba.com/pickem): Predictive fan game centered on NBA matchups and outcomes.
- [Store](https://store.nba.com/): Official NBA Store for jerseys, apparel, and licensed merchandise.
- [NBA ID](https://www.nba.com/id): Fan account program with benefits, rewards, and personalized experiences.

## Help, Policies & Corporate
- [About the NBA](https://www.nba.com/about): Overview of the league, organization, and business operations.
- [Contact Us](https://contact.nba.com/): Official NBA contact and customer support entry point.
- [Careers](https://careers.nba.com/): NBA jobs, internships, and career opportunities across league offices.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nba.com/privacy-policy): Privacy practices governing NBA digital properties and services.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.nba.com/termsofuse): Terms governing use of NBA websites, apps, and content.
- [Accessibility](https://www.nba.com/accessibility): Accessibility statement and support information for NBA digital services.
